notes.general_comments:
Overall performance across all candidates varied significantly and candidates generally dealt with
microeconomic and macroeconomic topics equally effectively. Questions 9, 22, 26 and 29, were answered
most successfully. Questions 2, 3, 10, 12, and 30, were answered correctly by fewer than 50 per cent of the
candidates. Questions on macroeconomics were answered better than those on macroeconomics.
